section.title: VSM malfunction indicator
section.p: Vehicle Stability Management (VSM) can be deactivated when a malfunction has been detected in the Electronic Power Steering system or Vehicle Stability Management (VSM). If the Electronic Stability Control (ESC) indicator light () or Electronic Power Steering system warning light () remains on, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

note.p: When replacing tires and wheels, make sure they are the same size as the original tires and wheels installed. Driving with varying tire or wheel sizes may diminish any supplemental safety benefits of the Vehicle Stability Management (VSM).
